## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    \lambda = \sum_{i = 1}^S p_i^2
$${#eq-simpson}

$$
    \frac{1}{\lambda} = \frac{1}{\sum_{i = 1}^S p_i^2}
$${#eq-simpson-inverse}

$$
    1 - \lambda = 1 - \sum_{i = 1}^S p_i^2
$${#eq-gini-simpson}
Probability of interspecific encounter (PIE).
